# Healthcare

Selected MBA work focused on healthcare delivery, reimbursement, clinical operations, informatics, and the relationship between evidence, incentives, and patient outcomes.

## Healthcare Informatics

Work from MBA 673 — Healthcare Information Systems combines healthcare application with SQL, R, clinical data, visualization, and decision support.

### Analysis Report One: What's Your Data Strategy?

An analysis of defensive and offensive data strategy in healthcare, using nutrition-related clinical data to examine early risk identification, data quality, and transitions of care.

[Read the publication →](informatics/analysis-report-01/index.qmd)

### Analysis Report Two: Data, Data Everywhere

An analysis of how connected clinical data can move healthcare from information collection to action, using nutrition support, laboratory, and ICU data to examine interoperability, clinical decision support, and earlier risk identification.

[Read the publication →](informatics/analysis-report-02/index.qmd)

### Analysis Report Three: Information Systems and Healthcare Provider Interactions

An analysis of how EHR design, documentation standards, workflow fit, and data quality affect provider interactions with healthcare information systems, using ICU weight and dietitian documentation to examine usability, trust, and readiness for advanced analytics.

[Read the publication →](informatics/analysis-report-03/index.qmd)
